summary: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps has closed the Strait of Hormuz and fired missiles at commercial shipping, while the United States conducted a third round of strikes against approximately 140 Iranian military targets. Iranian missile barrages targeted Qatar, Bahrain, the UAE, Oman, Kuwait, and Jordan, with interceptions reported and debris injuries in Qatar. Israel has frozen sensitive operations in southern Lebanon at U.S. request amid fears of wider regional escalation.
key_points: IRGC officially announced closure of Strait of Hormuz and fired missile at merchant vessel, causing damage and exchanges of fire. (Source: @pkpoi/143236)
U.S. Central Command conducted third round of strikes this week against Iran after IRGC attacked Cyprus-flagged container ship GFS Galaxy in Strait of Hormuz. (Source: @amitsegal/62960)

Iranian missile attacks targeted Qatar, Bahrain, UAE, Oman, Kuwait, and Jordan using multiple ballistic missile types including Ghadir, Emad, Kheibar Shekan, Fateh-110, Zolfaghar. (Source: @naya_foriraq/82505)
Qatar air defenses intercepted ballistic missiles; three people including a child injured by interception debris. (Source: @shin_persian/7686, @Faytuks_Network/4845)
Bahrain sirens activated as Iranian retaliation continues; officials urge civilians to seek shelter. (Source: @shin_persian/7688)
UAE air defense systems engaged missile threats identified outside national borders; situation described as stable. (Source: @SharghDaily/171390)
Commercial shipping through Strait of Hormuz dropped 90% with only 11 vessels transiting in 24 hours. (Source: @kianmeli1/88776)
United States demanded Israel freeze sensitive military operations in southern Lebanon to avoid wider escalation during U.S.-Iran confrontation. (Source: @pkpoi/143231)

sections.executive_summary: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps has closed the Strait of Hormuz and fired missiles at commercial shipping, while the United States conducted a third round of strikes against approximately 140 Iranian military targets. Iranian missile barrages targeted Qatar, Bahrain, the UAE, Oman, Kuwait, and Jordan, with interceptions reported and debris injuries in Qatar. Israel has frozen sensitive operations in southern Lebanon at U.S. request amid fears of wider regional escalation.

points: Explosions reported at the Bushehr nuclear reactor complex and the Asaluyeh industrial zone in southern Iran, with local sources indicating at least four separate strikes on Bushehr targets in the latest wave. (Source: @pkpoi/143237, @inon_yttach/9368, @New_security8200/202435)

IRGC Aerospace Force launched a large-scale retaliatory barrage employing solid- and liquid-fueled ballistic missiles — specifically Ghadir, Emad, Kheibar Shekan, Fateh-110, and Zolfaghar — claiming destruction of a U.S. MQ-9 Reaper drone warehouse in Jordan. (Source: @naya_foriraq/82505)

United States Central Command struck approximately 140 military targets across Iran in a third round of attacks this week, following the IRGC's attack on the Cyprus-flagged container ship GFS Galaxy in the Strait of Hormuz. (Source: @amitsegal/62960, @mamlekate/103869)
A new wave of U.S. strikes hit the port cities of Mahshahr and Bandar Kangan, according to Iranian social media reports. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/75642)
Bushehr International Airport resumed flight operations after a four-month suspension, signaling a partial return to normalcy amid ongoing hostilities. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/376483)

IRGC General Mohsen Rezaei, a senior regime figure, declared that revenge for martyrs' blood is a serious revolutionary obligation and warned that Trump and Netanyahu have crossed Iran's red lines, requiring decisive and proportional punishment. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/376489)

The United States demanded Israel freeze all sensitive military operations in southern Lebanon until the U.S.-Iran escalation clarifies and Israel-Lebanon negotiations progress, fearing Israeli action could trigger wider regional conflict. (Source: @pkpoi/143231)
The Israeli government extended the special home front emergency declaration until July 28 due to ongoing security developments. (Source: @yediotnews25/132546)
IDF reserve Battalion 551 completed its seventh combat rotation in southern Lebanon after two months of continuous operations. (Source: @idf_telegram/24602)

A technical malfunction caused erroneous emergency alerts to be sent to mobile phones in central Israel; the IDF confirmed no security threat and is investigating. (Source: @almogboker78/17700, @idf_telegram/24601, @inon_yttach/9377)
Emergency regulations were extended across Israel until July 28 with government approval via telephone vote. (Source: @naya_foriraq/82509)
No specific developments regarding Gaza or the West Bank were reported in the provided messages during this period.
The United States dispatched a team to Beirut to reinforce the Israel-Hezbollah ceasefire amid rising regional tensions. (Source: @pkpoi/143234)
Artillery shelling was reported in the Deir Saryan and Al-Qantara areas, though details on casualties or damage were not provided. (Source: @redlinkleb/30950)
An airstrike targeted the Al-Mansouri area; no further specifics on ordnance or effects were given. (Source: @redlinkleb/30941)
Israel froze sensitive operations in southern Lebanon per U.S. request to avoid escalation during the U.S.-Iran confrontation. (Source: @pkpoi/143231)
IRGC claimed destruction of a U.S. MQ-9 drone warehouse in Jordan, indicating the reach of Iranian missile retaliation beyond immediate neighbors. (Source: @naya_foriraq/82505)

No direct reports of military activity in Syria or Iraq were present in the provided messages; however, the missile types employed (Ghadir, Emad, Kheibar Shekan, Fateh-110, Zolfaghar) are known to be deployed by Iranian-backed forces in both countries.

Qatar's air defenses continuously intercepted ballistic missile attacks; the Interior Ministry confirmed three civilians, including one child, were injured by falling interception debris. (Source: @shin_persian/7686, @Faytuks_Network/4845)

Bahrain experienced repeated siren activations as Iranian missile retaliation continued; the Ministry of Interior urged residents to seek immediate shelter and follow official channels. (Source: @shin_persian/7688, @Faytuks_Network/4842, @lelotsenzura/93520)

UAE air defense systems engaged inbound missile threats identified outside national borders; the National Emergency Crisis and Disaster Management Authority (NCEMA) advised the public to remain in safe locations and avoid contact with debris. (Source: @SharghDaily/171390, @shin_persian/7684)

Oman's Musandam governorate, bordering the Strait of Hormuz, was attacked by UAVs; Omani maritime security responded to a distress call from a Cyprus-flagged commercial vessel off Musandam. (Source: @asafroz/51322, @naya_foriraq/82518)
IRGC targeted the UAE, Qatar, Bahrain, Kuwait, Jordan, and Oman with missiles and drones in retaliation for U.S. strikes on Iranian territory. (Source: @mamlekate/103869)

Commercial traffic through the Strait of Hormuz collapsed by 90%, with only 11 vessels (8 tankers, 3 cargo ships) transiting in the past 24 hours according to tracking data. (Source: @kianmeli1/88776)
The UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) issued an updated warning (083-26 Update 002) for the Strait of Hormuz following attacks on merchant shipping. (Source: @shin_persian/7690, @inon_yttach/9371)

key_developments: IRGC declared Strait of Hormuz closed and fired missile at merchant ship, prompting U.S. confirmation of severe damage to Cyprus-flagged GFS Galaxy with one crew missing and engine room fire. (Source: @pkpoi/143236, @inon_yttach/9366)

U.S. Central Command executed third strike wave against ~140 Iranian military targets after IRGC attacked commercial shipping; Iran retaliated with multi-missile barrage against six Gulf states and Jordan. (Source: @amitsegal/62960, @mamlekate/103869)

Qatar intercepted ballistic missiles but suffered three civilian injuries from debris; Bahrain sirens sounded repeatedly as Iranian missile attacks continued. (Source: @shin_persian/7686, @Faytuks_Network/4845, @shin_persian/7688)
UAE air defenses engaged inbound missiles identified outside borders; Oman's Musandam peninsula targeted by UAVs and merchant vessel distress reported
